changes.summary: Append a human accept/reject/request_changes/mark_reviewed revision. The action requires expected_revision, reason, actor and idempotency_key; it never edits source, entities or relations.
List review decisions in revision order.

review.status_change: appends a new architecture revision; prior revisions remain
review.idempotency: same key and payload returns the recorded revision; different payload returns scope_conflict

acyclic.coverage: complete over the declared candidate dependency graph in scope
limitations: runtime cycles are out of scope
